# RFC 7541, appendix C.2 to C.6, written by scripts/hpack_tables.py from the RFC's text.
# example SECTION MAXSIZE new|same: a block; new begins with an empty dynamic table of MAXSIZE octets,
# same goes on with the one the example before left. Then block HEX, field NAME VALUE for each field
# of the decoded list in order, entry NAME VALUE for the dynamic table after it from the newest,
# and size N, its size. | stands for a space inside a value.
example C.2.1 4096 new
block 400a637573746f6d2d6b65790d637573746f6d2d686561646572
field custom-key custom-header
entry custom-key custom-header
size 55
example C.2.2 4096 new

field :path /sample/path
size 0

block 100870617373776f726406736563726574
field password secret
size 0
example C.2.4 4096 new
block 82
field :method GET
size 0

size 57
